reviews.text: Excellent service, good communication, patient with people who don't know much about the business, and very kind. The shop has everything you need at a good price, and the animals are beautiful and well cared for. I will definitely shop again.

After buying marine animals from this store, the experience has been very positive.
The shipments arrived perfectly packaged, the corals arrived in excellent condition, and Jorge was very attentive and helpful.
Excellent service, I'm leaving very happy with my guinea pig.

Excellent service from the shop, high-quality corals.
I placed the order yesterday and it arrived at my house at noon today.

I highly recommend them. They're incredibly friendly, provide excellent service, and explain everything in detail, answering any questions you may have.

I bought a snake and I'm very happy with it. The shipping was super fast.
I bought a wonderful hamster there, but the workers were very unfriendly.
Google says the place is open from 5pm but there's a sign on the door saying they're closed in the afternoons during the summer. Please be a little more considerate of your customers' time.
10-star shop. Premium corals and fish at great prices. The staff are very professional and attentive, especially with online tracking of live animals.

I don't usually pay upfront, but this guy is 100% reliable. I paid him before he shipped it, and he was very attentive throughout the entire process. He called me on the day of shipment and kept me updated.

I highly recommend him. If I need anything, I'll definitely contact him. He's incredibly reliable. 🙌🏼🙌🏼🙌🏼

I bought a hamster here a few weeks ago, and for about two or three weeks it was doing well. But then I started noticing that the hamster had black and red parasites, and I was planning to take it to the vet. However, last night it became so weak due to the large number of parasites that it couldn't walk; it was falling on its back. The parasites are embedded in its skin, and I know this because it was in the shop before I bought it. When I had it in the box after buying it and was bringing it home, I saw small parasites crawling on the bedding. At first, I thought that, of course, they could have been from outside, but in this case, they weren't. I don't think selling infected hamsters is hygienic, mainly because this hamster I got from here was in the same cage as another hamster, and the owner told us they had babies. I'm not sure, but I don't see this as sanitary, and I recommend that before buying pets from this shop, you check the pet's well-being.
Good service.
Super friendly! We happened to pass by the store and they gave us great service!
I received excellent service and the store has everything you need for your pets; highly recommended.
It's the best store in terms of customer service; they're always super attentive to your shipments, and the quality of the corals, fish, and invertebrates is amazing.

If you're looking for a go-to place for marine aquariums, Tierra y Mar Shop is unbeatable. They have an amazing selection of corals (SPS, LPS, Zoanthus) and spectacular fish. I love that they don't just sell the animals, but also advise you and offer everything you need for reef maintenance. Jorge's passion for animals shines through from the moment he speaks to you. We'll definitely be back.
One of the best aquarium shops in Spain. Excellent service, high-quality corals, fish, and everything you need. Highly recommended. Jorge is very attentive with shipments and answers any questions.

Great store! I've made several purchases and the service has been fantastic, the shipping was excellent, and all the animals and accessories I bought arrived in perfect condition. I'm extremely happy with them. Best regards.
The care, treatment, and quality of the animals are top-notch.
My order just arrived, everything was still warm, in perfect condition as always, and the corals are beautiful. Thank you so much!

I'm very grateful for your service and the quality of the animals. You were very professional and attentive, and I highly recommend this shop.

I recommend Tierra y Mar again, and Jorge in particular, for his kindness and excellent work. It was a pleasure.

I've been a regular shopper at this store for several years now and I have absolutely no complaints. Jorge is always very attentive and the prices are more than competitive! I recommend it without hesitation.
Excellent shop for corals and marine fish. High-quality, very healthy specimens, excellent service.

I bought some corals for my aquarium. They arrived in perfect condition, and I was immediately able to check the quality of the euphyllia corals; they are very healthy and beautiful.

Thanks, Jorge.

A great shop!! I've bought from them online several times and everything has been great. Jorge takes care of the shipping; he calls you the day before to let you know everything. I'll definitely be back to order more beautiful corals.

It breaks my heart to walk past this shop and see birds crammed into cages, with hardly any space or stimulation. It's hard not to feel distressed knowing they are animals meant to fly, and they are being deprived of their natural instincts to live behind bars. And the same goes for the other animals they have... They aren't objects, they are living beings. I hope that as a society we stop normalizing confining animals just to sell them.
I would love for us to one day leave this sales model behind and embrace more ethical ways of caring for animals.
Highly recommended shop. Friendly service and very good quality fish and corals.
Jorge's service was outstanding; a trustworthy place for advice and recommendations for our pets.
It's not bad at all, but I didn't find what I was looking for.

They are very kind and very fast. I just asked about a coral, and I asked if they could show it to me via video, and they even made a video call to show me all the corals they have and what I'm going to receive. Thank you very much, the colors are very vibrant and on top of that, shipping is free for orders over €100.

I bought corals online for delivery to Madrid. It went great. Excellent communication via WhatsApp to arrange the delivery date and time, excellent packaging (floating upside down, a large cooler, and two heat packs), and the Euphylla even had two heads, which I thought was only one given the price. They're still acclimating, but they look very promising.
I made another online purchase from Tierra y Mar for my marine aquarium, and as always, everything was great. Good quality materials, excellent communication, and perfect shipping!
This shop is 100% recommended. Jorge is a great professional and the service is unbeatable. Thank you!
Excellent service from this shop and from Jorge, who went out of his way to ensure we could enjoy his euphyllias in all their splendor. Highly recommended.

I've bought from them several times in recent years, and the corals have always been healthy, the shipping has been perfect, and the prices are very good. They have a huge variety on their website and are constantly updating it.
Plus, whenever I've needed anything, they've always responded super quickly and been incredibly friendly—a real gem! ❤️
Everything was perfect, thank you, everything was excellent 👌 …

Very fast, excellent service, 100/100. I would definitely go back. Highly recommended. A great variety of animals: birds, rabbits, very docile snakes, guinea pigs, hamsters, parakeets, etc. 10 out of 10.
I just bought some coral and a fish, and the shipping was perfect and very fast. Jorge's service was, as always, excellent, and the animals arrived in perfect condition.
Very professional, always great service, and excellent value for money. I've ordered several times and it's always been a breeze. Highly recommended! 🥰🥰🥰 …
A great store for buying everything you need for a marine aquarium, with good prices and excellent customer service and shipping.

Hi, I ordered some acropora corals and the quality is truly incredible. After more than a week, everything is still in good condition and the shipping was fantastic. Don't hesitate to do business with these people. The personal service is exceptional; they clearly love the hobby! In the photos, the corals are settling into my aquarium.
A highly recommended marine pet store. Jorge's service is excellent, the prices are very good and competitive, and the animals are healthy and in perfect condition. Super fast shipping.

I recently bought a rabbit from this shop and everything has been great. The staff was very friendly and helpful, giving me all the advice I needed about its care and feeding. The rabbit was in perfect condition; you can tell they take very good care of it. Plus, the service was friendly and professional. I'm very happy with my purchase and will definitely be back. Highly recommended! 🐰💚
Very attentive, good quality and healthy animals
I do not recommend it; sick animals, a lot of disrespect, and a hostile environment.

This review is for online orders. I've placed six online orders... all super fast with next-day delivery. The packaging is excellent; each coral comes in its own individual bag with attached polystyrene foam, inside a box lined with paper, and depending on the season, a heater is also included... to ensure no damage or problems occur during shipping. The staff is incredibly responsive by phone; if you have any questions, or like me, if you prefer to pick up your order at the shipping company, you can send them the order details via WhatsApp and they'll process it immediately.

100% recommended, and the quality/price ratio is unbeatable.
The animals are in terrible condition; their sale should be prohibited, especially given the way they are kept.

I've been searching for years for a reliable online store to buy my corals and fish, and I finally found this one. I'm so happy with my purchases. Everything arrives in perfect condition and the shipping is very well done.

A year ago we came down from Zaragoza to get a rabbit because we couldn't find anywhere in this area that we felt comfortable keeping. This December we're going back for another rabbit, and of course we'll return to Tierra y Mar. We've stayed in touch with them with a few questions and we're very happy. 10 out of 10.
We contacted Jorge for maintenance and we're delighted. They take care of all the upkeep of our aquarium, so we just have to sit back and enjoy. A 100% recommended service.

I've been buying corals from your website for a while now and I'd never stopped to leave a comment. After so long as a customer, I can say that everything always arrives in perfect condition and I'm extremely happy with the service you always provide. Thanks, Jorge, keep it up!

We bought a mini lop 20 days ago and everything was great. A guy helped us and explained everything we needed for him, he was super friendly, and we're all super happy with our bunny. He's super affectionate and super calm 🐰🥰 …

Good afternoon, Jorge sold us a beautiful little blue lop rabbit. Yesterday we took him to a vet in Teruel for an examination, and everything is perfect; she even fell in love with him. Thank you so much for making my son Jaime so happy. The service was excellent; we made the purchase over the phone since we're from Teruel. And Jorge was incredibly kind throughout. I highly recommend him. A million thanks, Jorge, for everything!
Nice shop, great selection of marine-related items, and Jorge was very attentive and friendly. It was a pleasure to meet him after so many online purchases. 😊 …

We wanted a bunny for my children, and Jorge gave us excellent information about all their care. It's been a month now, and the little animals are now part of the family; they're doing wonderfully. Highly recommended, especially since they offer a free vet visit, which gives you a lot of peace of mind. We definitely recommend them.

I'm very late to the party because I saw this store's Facebook ad. In 2016, I bought a beautiful Cunipic ferret. It only lasted a week because it had a birth defect. The vet charged me €200.

I complained, and they blocked me. Very professional. I hope you got your money's worth from the €350 you charged me for my ferret.
Excellent service. Highly recommended. The best pet shop in Valencia.
I absolutely do not recommend this store. I bought a parakeet, and what a surprise! They told me that if I wanted it, I had to buy two more things 🥺. They weren't even polite. …
Great! Advice. Service. Product quality.
The guy who helped us was great; we took home a hamster and he explained everything to us because we were new to this. Thank you so much!!
Today I went to buy a hamster and the service was excellent. It's in great condition, very playful, and it cost me 19 euros. We're so happy to have Puchi at home!

I bought a mini lop rabbit a few months ago. I'm absolutely delighted with her, but she's grown much bigger than a mini lop should be. Today, during one of her checkups, the vet confirmed that she's a lop, not a mini lop. I think it's awful that they sell a breed that isn't actually one.

We went to buy two hamsters. We asked and were told we could take two, that they would get used to each other and that we wouldn't have any problems. Within a few hours, they started fighting and haven't stopped; we had to separate them. We called to see what solution they could offer, and they didn't give us any. It's unacceptable that they gave us bad advice and couldn't help us from one day to the next. Clearly, we don't recommend them and we won't be back.

Jorge is a lovely guy. I haven't been to the store, but I've bought from them online many times. For me, it's the best store around in terms of prices, customer service, and product quality. 100% recommended.

BEWARE, SCAM: I excitedly bought a baby rabbit and was told they were all in perfect health, etc. I found it strange that they told me I had to give it a vaccination myself when they're supposed to give it to you ready to go home. My rabbit only lasted three weeks; they gave it to us sick. Two months ago, the same thing happened to my friend; her rabbit only lasted a month and died because, of course, they all arrived sick. Please don't buy your pets here because you'll be extremely disappointed.

Well, I've bought online several times and Jorge's service has always been excellent.
The packaging and delivery were great.
The corals I've bought have always exceeded my expectations; they're fantastic. For me, it's currently the best online store.

Jorge is very friendly. He helps you focus on what you need (in my case, marine supplies), and if you need something he doesn't have in stock, he'll order it for you without hesitation. He often gets great prices, and if you're patient, you can find some real bargains.
Besides, we should support businesses that take risks and open up right in the city center.
Excellent service. I called beforehand to ask if they had any toy rabbits, and they didn't have any at the time. They saved my contact information and called me as soon as they had some available. …
Definitely my go-to shop! Professional and friendly staff, and very careful shipping; as always, the corals arrive in perfect condition. Thank you for everything!
